title: First Indochina War (1946–1954)
key_facts: Conflict between French colonial forces and the Việt Minh led by Hồ Chí Minh
Major Cold War precursor in Southeast Asia; intensified after 1949
Decisive Việt Minh victory at Điện Biên Phủ (1954) preceded the Geneva Accords
causes: Anticolonial nationalism following Japanese occupation and World War II
Competing visions of independence vs. restoration of French control
outcome: French withdrawal from Indochina under the 1954 Geneva Accords
Provisional division of Vietnam at the 17th parallel and scheduled elections
Set stage for the Vietnam War and conflicts in Laos and Cambodia
impacts: Drew Cold War blocs into Indochina
Shaped strategies for the subsequent Vietnam War
